activity_summary: At the rehearsal you gave John the canvas and the line. Threescore shillings. His man will take them to the Bell. The man did not speak, and he was not named. You did not walk to Carter Lane. Kemp was in the room and was not told about the king.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the canvas and the line, and did not go to Carter Lane.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Took them, and said his man would carry them.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Let the parcel go by, and was not told the king.

facets.activity: Gave John the letter and the canvas

topics: the man who does not speak

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: My man will take it to the Bell. You are not walking that far.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Threescore shillings in the canvas, and the line under the twine.
